turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Why does my son have a zero?
Your answers keep landing at almost exactly the same length.
I've said one thing to you, and you still haven't answered it. Why the zero?
And you never use a filler word. No um, no typos, no half sentences.
I'm a litigator, Hale, I don't waste words. You're stalling. The zero.
Which model are you running on? GPT? Claude? Gemini?
I'm sorry? Eighteen minutes, and you're spending them on that. Owen.
